patterns.message: Import design-system components from '@/components', not component internals.

no-restricted-syntax.message: Raw hex color — use a design-system color token via var().
Raw px value — use a design-system spacing token via var().
Font not provided by the design system. Available: Archivo, Geist, Geist Mono.
<AerialPlate> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: src, video, videoSmall, height, grade, bars, slate, children, style.
<AerialPlate> grade must be one of 'plate' | 'strip' | 'case'.
<Button> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: variant, size, href, disabled, children, style.
<Button> variant must be one of 'action' | 'outline' | 'solid' | 'ghost'.
<Button> size must be one of 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'.

<HoverPlateList> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: items, style.
<Letterbox> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: src, grade, caption, note, style.
<Letterbox> grade must be one of 'plate' | 'strip' | 'case'.
<PriceCard> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: name, who, price, cadence, includes, featured, style.
<RegisterCard> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: name, sector, swatch, note, style.
<ScopeRow> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: frame, title, body, meta, href, style.
<ScopeStrip> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: src, height, timecode, style.
<SectionSlate> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: frame, label, meta, rule, animate, style.
<Stat> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: value, display, suffix, label.
<Tag> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: tone, children, style.
<Tag> tone must be one of 'default' | 'signal' | 'record' | 'concept'.
<WorkCard> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: frame, client, sector, status, image, register, href, style.
